notes.title: Forgotlings launches on June 12—Enjoy the brand new release date trailer!
notes.notes:
Release date announcement 📢 
It's official: Forgotlings launches on June 12!

Mark your calendars 🗓️ make sure you've wishlisted on Steam 🎮 and enjoy the brand new Forgotlings release date trailer below 🎬✨

[previewyoutube=wfjXWA5QW78;full][/previewyoutube]
And that’s not all—we want as many of you as possible to experience the first game in our franchise, Forgotton Anne. Stay tuned, as we’ll soon be announcing massive discounts! 🚀

Forgotlings Release Date Revealed – The Next Chapter in the Forgotten Lands Arrives on June 12th 2025
New Trailer Showcases Stunning Hand-Drawn Adventure from the Creators of Forgotton Anne

After five years in the making and a successful Kickstarter campaign, the highly-anticipated sequel to Forgotton Anne is nearly here. Throughline Games has officially revealed that Forgotlings will launch on the 12th of June for Steam, and is expected shortly after on other platforms. To celebrate, a brand-new Release Date Trailer has been unveiled today, giving players a deeper look at the game’s breathtaking world & cinematic 2D handcrafted storytelling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/caad2a89f463b04740c511461bec20153d41a0ac.png
Fans of emotionally driven, story-rich games who have yet to experience the unique universe of Forgotton Anne should consider taking advantage of upcoming discounts on the title — an ideal way to experience the world before Forgotlings arrives.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/65f033a3ab0c4611dfc455c9d681d43fa2b87cf2.png

A New Standalone Adventure in the World of the Forgotten

In Forgotlings, players take on the role of Fig, a charismatic posing doll navigating a fractured world to unite five forgotling tribes. Forgotlings are sentient lost objects longing to rediscover their purpose as a Beast threatens to destroy the Forgotten Lands. As he explores lush forgotten landscapes, battles enigmatic foes, and uncovers ancient secrets, Fig must determine his place in a world where memories are power.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/431ffacf93f20faa98b9959ec44dccf418a07c2c.png
With stunning hand-drawn visuals, a haunting score featuring renowned choir ensemble Theatre of Voices, a deep narrative with choice mechanics, and an expansive, action-packed world, Forgotlings builds upon its predecessor’s beloved storytelling while offering an entirely new, standalone experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/cab1dbbfe2ea60fba0b76cab3630d09aec2ebba6.png
"In a world increasingly divided, Forgotlings invites players to escape into the Forgotten Lands—where their choices shape the fate of a fractured society. This is a story of belonging, of tribal factions at odds, and of finding purpose in a time of uncertainty.” says Alfred Nguyen, Creative Director at Throughline Games. “While we didn’t set out to make a timely allegory, the themes of Forgotlings resonate now more than ever."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44219072/19c6ed6d5ca874ba1b0c167cc02377dcac341f3f.png

Wishlist Forgotlings Now – And Watch the New Trailer!
Forgotlings is now available for wishlisting on Steam, and players eager to experience the original world should stay tuned for upcoming news of Forgotton Anne’s Steam Spring Sale participation.
